scripts.dev:engine: cd services/engine && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.migrate: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma format && pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:deploy: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:push: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma format && pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd packages/database && pnpm exec tsx prisma/seed.ts
